GENERAL CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT (Excerpts)

This Agreement is entered into as of February 12, 2023, by and between RIVERTON HOSPITALITY GROUP, LLC ("Owner") and ARROYO CONSTRUCTION COMPANY, INC. ("Contractor").

ARTICLE 3 — CONTRACT PRICE
3.1 Guaranteed Maximum Price. The Guaranteed Maximum Price ("GMP") is FOUR MILLION EIGHT HUNDRED TWENTY THOUSAND DOLLARS ($4,820,000), subject to adjustment for approved Change Orders.

ARTICLE 5 — PAYMENT
5.1 Applications for Payment. On the 25th day of each month, Contractor shall submit an Application for Payment ("AFP") for work completed during the preceding month, with appropriate supporting documentation.
5.2 Owner Review. Owner shall, within ten (10) business days of receipt of an AFP, either (a) approve the AFP in full; (b) approve the AFP in part with a specific written explanation of the disputed portion; or (c) reject the AFP in writing with specific reasons.
5.3 Payment Terms. Owner shall pay the undisputed portion of each AFP within THIRTY (30) DAYS of receipt. Failure to provide the written response described in Section 5.2 within ten (10) business days shall constitute approval of the AFP in full.
5.4 Interest on Late Payment. Unpaid amounts shall accrue interest at the rate of 1.5% per month from the date payment was due.

ARTICLE 11 — DISPUTE RESOLUTION
11.1 The parties shall first attempt to resolve any dispute through good-faith negotiation. If unresolved within 30 days, either party may initiate litigation in the courts of Marion County, Westbrook.
11.2 Attorney's Fees. The prevailing party in any litigation arising under this Agreement shall be entitled to reasonable attorney's fees and costs.

ARTICLE 14 — TERMINATION
14.1 Termination for Cause. Either party may terminate for material breach upon 14 days' written notice and opportunity to cure.

EXECUTED:
For Owner:       /s/ Sarah Vance, Director of Development, RHG LLC, 02/12/2023
For Contractor:  /s/ Luis Arroyo, President, Arroyo Construction Co., Inc., 02/12/2023
